The '''Jandoon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="R" /> The [[Brizzit]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Jandoon]] was the primary [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the system.

After the inhabitants of Jandoon died out centuries before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it was rumored that the spirits of the dead roamed the Jandoon system. These rumors tended to keep visitors and travelers away from the system.<ref name="R" />

The system was the site of the [[Battle of Jandoon]].
